_note: Five boards, one panel, and every one of them sits behind a real site:
PublishHistory reads `sites.publishHistory` for the rows and `sites.get` for
whether anything is serving before it renders a single row, so none of these
states is reachable without a server. The probe answers those two procedures
over the transport the client actually uses (httpBatchLink + superjson) and
the recipe CLICKS its way to the state — open the picker, Continue, confirm —
so the panel takes its own branches rather than being handed a prop.
1440x900, the board's own frame, with the modal in `#bk-overlay-root` (the
contrast sweep is scoped there, because the panel behind the scrim is not
what these boards are about).
THE 24 GUTTER, which is what most of the drift here was. Every modal in this
family insets its body 24 from the frame: 184:29 and 184:30 are 392 in a 440,
184:7's picker rows are 512 in a 560. `MODAL_BODY_CLASS` gives every modal
body 16. Five boards agreeing is not one board disagreeing — but the chassis
is measured against eight other boards, so the extra 8 went on these bodies
(`MODAL_INSET`) and the chassis was left alone.
WHAT DRIFTED on this board:
· the rows were rounded 6 against the board's 8 and 528 wide against 512.
· the LIVE row is deliberately unselectable, and flowbite's disabled
`light` button paints gray-100 with a transparent edge — so the one row
that says what is live was the only grey one in a list of white bands.
184:7 draws it white and bordered like the rest; `disabled:` utilities
now hold it there and the `live` chip plus the tooltip carry the fact.
· the SELECTED row (184:11) tints and keeps the neutral edge; it also
carried an accent border, which reads as focus rather than choice.
· the row titles were 13/18.57 (the inherited line-height) against 13/20.
NOT anchored, and why:
fixed Figma height (400/300/260/280/264) and the shipped modals are content
-sized, so the number is the frame's, not the design's. Their width and
radius WERE measured and match (2026-09-08: 560 for the picker via
kind="form", 440 for the rest via kind="question" — two of which were
`form`, i.e. 560 wide against a board that draws 440, and that is fixed
here).
The modal TITLE (16/24, and error-text on 453:4067) and the FOOTER buttons
both are the Modal chassis. MODAL_TITLE_CLASS is 14 and MODAL_FOOT_CLASS
caps its buttons at 28 with a comment naming the boards it was measured
against, one of which is 184:24 itself. Two readings of one primitive; a
screen board does not re-settle it (cf. BK_TEXT_INPUT_THEME).
184:6 the ✕ — OverlayMount owns dismissal for every modal in the editor.
CONTRAST: one failure at 4.38 — 'published 2d ago' in the SELECTED row,
ink-muted on accent-tint. Both are the board's own tokens (184:13 on
184:11) and the same pair already baselined on history-saves-changes.
BOARD-COPY (2026-09-08). The rows' text folds apart on the live side (the
version and its suffix are separate text nodes), which accounts for most of
the leads. One is real and is NOT fixed: the board's meta line names the
PUBLISHER — 'published 2d ago · Ali' — and `PublishHistoryRow` carries
id/version/completedAt/deploymentId/rollbackable/rolledBackFrom and no
author. Same call this panel already records for board 949:4474's live
banner ('by Ali'): no column on publish_build_jobs carries one, so the clause
is absent rather than invented.
